page.description: deepin 25.2.0 ISO: architecture, size and the publisher's SHA256SUMS.
page.intro: A Debian-based desktop from Deepin Technology with its own Deepin Desktop Environment. One amd64 community image.
pros: Debian package base with Deepin's own store and tools.
One ISO, so no edition matrix.
The publisher publishes SHA256SUMS beside the image.
cons: Only amd64 is published for this build.
The desktop and apps are opinionated; less vanilla than upstream Debian.
The release date shown is the mirror directory date (2026-07-07).
No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed, so the page is logo-only.
page.previewNote: No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed for deepin; the page shows the logo only. No image was written to a USB stick and nothing was booted.
page.status: One image: the amd64 community ISO, written with dd or any image writer. Writing erases the stick; the installer then partitions or erases the target disk.
